category_edits.rationale: For all four datasets, weaken training-frequency attenuation from exponent -0.25 to -0.125. Preserve mean-one normalization, clipping, unseen-item and padding scales. The existing checkpoint buffer restores identical features at inference; model topology, embeddings, readout, loss and optimizer remain unchanged.

response.change_summary: Reduce the training-only frequency feature's attenuation consistently across all four HSTU category models, using existing checkpoint and predictor support.
